title: AI referral traffic
content: AI referral traffic is the set of visits that arrive when a person clicks a link inside an AI assistant's answer.

meta.aliases:
AI assistant traffic
LLM referral traffic
meta.why: Google Analytics groups visits from assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Copilot in an AI Assistant channel. That channel leaves out Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, which Search Console reports inside regular web search traffic.
meta.example: An analytics report shows 40 sessions in the AI Assistant channel, and the largest group of those sessions landed on a comparison page.
meta.check: Open the default channel report in Google Analytics, find the AI Assistant row, and list the landing pages those visits reached.
meta.limitation: Because Google Analytics assigns the channel from the referrer, a visit that arrives without referrer information is counted elsewhere, and an answer read without a click produces no visit.
